about: One made-up person's working day, Thursday 12 November 2026, and the next morning. Read by tests/test_a_day_in_the_life.py. 'spoken' runs through the conversation sessions' own runner (benchmarks/conversation_eval/sessions.run_session) with no model and with a stub cloud model; 'typed', 'offers' and 'lid' run through the real Live engine, offer rules and reminder delivery on the same day's clock. Every thing Heliox may raise without being asked is marked here: welcome, or not expected at all (then it is unwelcome).
